component.name: Loofi Fedora Tweaks
component.summary: Complete Fedora system management with AI, security, and window management

description.p: A comprehensive GUI control center for Fedora KDE 44 covering system maintenance, developer tooling, AI integration, security hardening, window management, virtualization, mesh networking, and workspace state management.

ul.li: Fedora KDE 44 Readiness Center — diagnostics for Plasma, Wayland, DNF5, Flatpak, NVIDIA, and more
Security Center with polkit-managed privileged operations
VM Quick-Create and VFIO GPU Passthrough
AI Lab integration
Loofi Link Mesh networking
State Teleport workspace snapshots
Replicator IaC / Ansible export
Optional headless Web API and user daemon
Added My Fedora Today health snapshots with bounded retention and corrupt-history fallback
Added trend-aware recurring, new, resolved, and worsening issue detection from normalized fingerprints
Added Action Center v2 recommendations with dedupe keys, correlation IDs, grouping, and safe next steps
Added read-only daemon/API snapshot collection without automatic repairs or background upgrades
Added Support Bundle v8 fields for snapshots, timelines, recurring fingerprints, recommendations, daemon status, and redaction

description.p: v11.0.0 "Harbor" - Unified Action Center, Daily Maintenance UX, Release Trust

ul.li: Added a Unified Action Center model for previewable readiness actions, queue state, rollback guidance, and history
Added read-only Daily Maintenance diagnostics for updates, Flatpak, firmware, services, journal warnings, disk usage, and package health
Added Support Bundle v7 fields for Action Center summaries, rollback hints, daemon/API status, and GitHub issue text export
Extended release validation to catch AppStream and workflow spec drift

description.p: v10.0.0 "Waypoint" - Release Upgrade Assistant & Guided UX

ul.li: Added Home and Maintenance entry points for the guided Upgrade Assistant
Expanded Fedora 45 preview planning with read-only compatibility checks
Added readiness plan, explain, and export CLI commands
Extended support bundles with release plan, target changes, action history, and update preview data
Redesigned the default navigation around five focused sidebar areas
Kept advanced pages available through search, favorites, direct routes, and Advanced mode
Added screen-aware and font-derived layout metrics for better Wayland and fractional scaling behavior
Updated dark, light, and high-contrast themes with roomier spacing and clearer selected states
Regenerated user-guide and wiki screenshots from the redesigned PyQt UI
Added a central route manifest for stable plugin and subroute navigation
Refactored command palette, quick actions, dashboard cards, breadcrumbs, and favorites to route IDs
Added Favorites v2 migration with stable persisted identifiers
Hardened action command validation, snapshot command validation, RPM imports, and packaging manifests

description.p: v7.0.0 "Aegis" - Safe Guided Actions & Fedora 44 Reliability

ul.li: Added readiness action planning, preview, confirmation, and verification
Added Action Inbox and Support Bundle v5 diagnostics
Hardened release metadata and workflow drift checks
Added Fedora KDE 44 Readiness Center with full diagnostics
Split optional Web API and daemon into subpackages
Extended support bundle to v3 with privacy-masked diagnostics
Updated COPR/workflow target to Fedora 44
